title: Ace Counts to Two
flavor: Double Attack deals its damage one card at a time. Count what each card does.
teaches: Boa Hancock is their bottom life card. Lead with Ace and his second hit flips her trigger onto the board as a blocker with your attacks spent. Lead with the leader instead: it takes the plain card, then Ace's Double Attack flips Boa with the first hit and wins with the second — a trigger blocker can't block the attack that revealed it.
